LESSON: DRAWING AND PAINTING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
Strand: Creating and Performing
Topic 2.1: Drawing and Painting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Drawing and Painting
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why is colour classification important in painting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. discuss harmony/unity in a picture
2. classify analogous colours on a colour wheel for painting
3. appreciate own and others pictures

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 3: appreciate own and others pictures

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: discuss harmony/unity in a picture
2. Practise: classify analogous colours on a colour wheel for painting

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Drawing and Painting.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is colour classification important in painting?
2. How does the colour affect the mood?
